response.original_title: De Kroongetuigeadvocaat: Het Verhaal van Onno de Jong
response.overview: Onno de Jong is the lawyer for the three most important crown witnesses in the history of Dutch organized crime: Fred Ros, Tony de G., and Nabil B. Thanks to them, the police and judicial authorities are achieving major successes in the fight against 'untouchable' top-level criminals such as Dino S., Willem Holleeder, and Ridouan Taghi. But the price is high. Onno de Jong and his wife are placed in an extremely rigorous security program following the murder of Derk Wiersum. For six months, they believe they are safe, but then things go wrong...
